name: PrintReady — KDP Print Preflight Checker: Fonts, DPI & Margins Checked Before Amazon Rejects Your Book
description:
How do I check my book's margins, fonts and image DPI before KDP review bounces it? It bounces it for a margin, a font, an image at 33 DPI — one slow upload-review-fix cycle at a time.
PrintReady checks your interior PDF the way the review does, repairs the structural defects, then RE-CHECKS the repaired file so you know before you upload.
WHAT IT CHECKS, PAGE BY PAGE
• One consistent trim size across the whole book
• Text running inside the 0.25in minimum margin
• Fonts that aren't embedded (standard Base-14 flagged separately — usually accepted)
• Every image's effective DPI at its placed size (300 target; under 200 flagged)
• Blank pages, rotated pages, CropBox/MediaBox mismatches
WHAT IT FIXES ON ITS OWN
• Page rotation baked into the content
• CropBox unified to MediaBox
Then the re-check shows the repaired file's true state — nothing is hidden, including consequences of the fixes themselves.
WHAT IT REPORTS — BUT NEVER FAKES
A 100-pixel image can't be "repaired" into a 300 DPI print image. You get the page, the placed size and the actual DPI, so you can swap in the real original.
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
Seeded 5-page 6×9 interior (margin violator, 33-DPI image, rotated page, CropBox mismatch, blank page): 2 structural repairs applied; re-check confirmed all 3 blocking errors, per page, with 0 invented fixes.
100% LOCAL & PRIVATE — no upload of your unpublished book, no per-file preflight fees, no subscription.
OUR GUARANTEE
If KDP rejects your interior for a problem PrintReady checks and cleared, send us the rejection notice and we refund you in full.
Windows 10/11, nothing else to install.
Scope: common KDP-style interior rules. Your printer's house rules win where they differ.
